GAO annually reports on federal programs, agencies, offices, and initiatives that have potentially duplicative goals or activities . This report discusses new opportunities for achieving billions of dollars in potential financial benefits .

GAO identified 148 new matters and recommendations in 43 new topic areas for Congress or federal agencies to improve efficiency and effectiveness of government . GAO estimates that fully addressing the remaining open matters could yield financial benefits of one hundred billion dollars or more .

Actions by Congress and federal agencies related to GAO’s Duplication & Cost Savings body of work have resulted in over $700 billion in financial benefits .

Since 2011, we have issued 142 matters for Congress and 1,907 recommendations for federal agencies to eliminate, reduce, or better manage fragmentation, overlap, or duplication . Actions by Congress and federal agencies in these areas have resulted in about $725 billion in financial benefits .

This report identifies 43 new topic areas where a broad range of federal agencies could achieve greater efficiency or effectiveness . For each area, we suggest matters for Congress and recommendations for federal agencies to reduce, eliminate, or better manage fragmentation, overlap, or duplication . This report is based upon work we previously conducted in accordance with generally accepted government auditing standards .

The Departments of the Air Force, Army, and Navy should better coordinate modular open systems approaches among portfolios of weapon programs . The Department of Health and Human Services could better manage fragmentation of efforts to assess public health emergency responses by implementing a coordinated, department-wide after-action program .

As of March 2025, Congress and agencies had fully or partially addressed 1,590 (about 78 percent) of the 2,049 matters and recommendations . Congress and federal agencies have addressed many of the matters we have identified, as shown in figure 2 and table 3 . Congress has identified approximately $725 billion in total financial benefits, including $57.8 billion in this 2025 report .

The Office of Management and Budget’s (OMB) Category Management initiative directed agencies across the federal government to buy more like a single enterprise . Cost savings of approximately $154.1 billion in fiscal years 2016 through 2023, and tens of billions of additional savings are possible .

The Small Business Administration implemented an oversight plan for its Paycheck Protection Program in December 2020 . SBA applied similar oversight controls to identify potentially ineligible or fraudulent applicants to its Restaurant Revitalization Fund .

Following enactment of the Fixing America’s Surface Transportation (FAST) Act in 2015, the IRS may realize additional financial benefits through continued enforcement of the FAST Act . The Social Security Administration and the Department of Veterans Affairs, among others, reduced improper overpayments .

Congress took steps to increase the minimum adjustment made for differences in diagnostic coding patterns between Medicare Advantage plans and traditional Medicare providers . Cost savings of about $2.5 billion from fiscal years 2013 through 2022, according to CBO, and tens of billions of dollars of additional savings are possible .

In February 2023, we reported that the threat posed by domestic terrorism was on the rise . The FBI and DHS’s Office of Intelligence and Analysis (I&A) did not report comprehensive domestic terrorism data . We recommended that the FBI and I&A improve collaboration to identify and counter domestic terrorism threats .

Interagency working groups can be a tool for forging successful partnerships . A comprehensive inventory of programs would be a critical tool to help identify and manage fragmentation, overlap, and duplication in federal programs . Despite legal requirements since 2011, the federal government has not yet fully developed such an inventory .

We identified 142 matters directed to Congress that have opportunity to address fragmentation, overlap, and duplication . Of these, 83 (58 percent) remained open as of March 2025 . We also identified 1,907 recommendations directed to federal agencies . Six agencies have at least 20 open recommendations .
More effective efforts to position the U.S. to address emerging wildlife diseases . DOD Wargames should better manage fragmentation of wargame efforts .

Of the 589 open matters and recommendations, we identified 170 as having the potential to yield financial benefits . The potential financial benefits shown in this table represent estimates of amounts we or others believe could accrue if steps are taken to implement the actions described . Section 21 of Public Law 111-139, enacted in February 2010, requires us to conduct routine investigations to identify programs, agencies, offices, and initiatives with duplicative goals and activities within departments and government-wide . Our objectives are to identify potentially significant topic areas of (a) fragmentation, overlap, and duplication, or (b) opportunities for cost savings and enhanced revenues that exist across the federal government .

The net benefit is a reflection of any financial or nonfinancial program improvements that exceed the costs of implementing our matters and recommendations . The steps that we took to assess the reliability of data vary but were chosen to accomplish the auditing requirement that the data be sufficiently reliable .

Of the 159 matters and recommendations introduced in this report, 148 are presented in appendices II and III . 11 matters were closed-implemented before this report was issued . For several new topic areas, all the recommendations were closed before the report was published .

To identify financial and other benefits realized as a result of implementing matters and recommendations, we interviewed relevant agency and program officials and gathered and analyzed data on the net benefit of such actions . For all estimates of financial benefits, we estimated a net benefit to account both for the positive effects of the action and any related implementation costs .

In July 2022, DOD reported that 24 percent of active duty service members experienced some level of food insecurity in 2019 . DOD’s policy is to provide military service members with appropriate nutrition to help ensure they can achieve and maintain performance . Each military service manages and operates its own food program with dining facilities .

Department of Defense (DOD) leaders have expressed concern that DOD is not adopting commercial technologies at the speed and scale needed to keep pace with foreign adversaries . Establishing common nutrition strategic goals, performance goals, and performance metrics will position DOD to better manage the fragmented food system .

The Department of Defense manages one of the largest real property portfolios within the federal government . This portfolio includes over 700,000 facilities with a replacement value of about $2.2 trillion . DOD has faced challenges in fully using, or reducing, real property that exceeds its needs .

The Department of Defense (DOD) spends over $1 trillion annually to provide the military forces needed to deter war and to protect the United States . In December 2024, DOD reported about $2.4 billion in confirmed fraud in fiscal year 2024 .

GAO made recommendations to DOD to establish data analytics as a method for preventing, detecting, and responding to fraud . If DOD prevented even one percent of the value of the confirmed fraud DOD previously reported, DOD could save one hundred million dollars or more over ten years .

A December 6, 2019 attack raised questions about the safety and security of personnel assigned to DOD installations and U.S. facilities hosting such training . While attending training at Naval Air Station Pensacola, Florida, a Saudi Arabian military student killed three service members and injured eight others .

The National Vetting Center was established to coordinate agency vetting efforts to identify individuals who present a threat to national security, border security, homeland security, or public safety . State updated its Foreign Affairs Manual to reflect the changes in DOD vetting . State is also working with DOD on improving data sharing and analysis through coordination steps planned for fiscal year 2025 .

A modular open systems approach can help DOD design weapon systems that take less time and money to sustain and upgrade . This approach includes a modular design and standard interfaces, which allows programs to easily replace components of a weapon system . It allows DOD to competitively upgrade the system with new, improved components that a greater variety of suppliers can make .

The Navy and Marine Corps have disagreed on the number of ships that should be available at any given time to conduct operations and training . This disagreement is in large part due to the Navy’s struggle to maintain the amphibious fleet . The Navy maintains a fleet of large amphibious warfare ships that are critical for Marine Corps missions .

GAO made two recommendations for the Secretary of the Navy, in coordination with the Commandant of the Marine Corps . The Navy concurred with these recommendations . Implementing these recommendations will help the Navy and Marine Corps better manage fragmentation in overseeing ship availability .

GAO provided a draft of this report section to OMB for review and comment . OMB provided technical comments, which GAO incorporated as appropriate . The judiciary’s U.S. Courts Design Guide (Design Guide) establishes standards for GSA and project stakeholders to follow when designing and constructing new federal courthouses .

Changes would have increased the size of these courthouses by almost 72,195 gross square feet (6 percent), and construction costs by approximately $143 million (12 percent) The changes would have raised construction costs . The judiciary did not agree or disagree with GAO’s recommendations .

GAO found that HHS led the initial federal response to the mpox outbreak in the United States . The initial response presented challenges similar to prior public health emergencies . HHS did not have a coordinated, department-wide after-action program that includes input from all relevant stakeholders .

HHS concurred with GAO’s recommendations and stated it was taking steps to implement them . As of January 2025, HHS had developed a standard operating procedure to establish a coordinated, department-wide after-action program .

The U.S. has the highest rates of maternal and infant death of developed, high-income countries . These adverse health outcomes are disproportionately higher among certain demographic groups . GAO observed a number of differences in the performance measures each of the three programs used to assess progress .

GAO-24-106605: Maternal and Infant Health: HHS Should Strengthen Processes for Measuring Program Performance . Thousands of service members transition from military service to civilian life each year . VA-DOD Joint Executive Committee had identified inventory of VA and DOD programs and processes intended to facilitate access to mental health services .

GAO found a lack of clearly defined roles between the two HHS components with key responsibilities for the national stockpile . This lack of clear roles resulted in confusion for jurisdictions that needed national stockpile assets . Timely sharing of information is critical to protecting public health .

GAO recommended that ASPR and CDC work with CDC to clearly define roles and responsibilities related to the national stockpile in a formal document and share that document with jurisdictions . ASPR expected to complete all actions to address the recommendation in summer 2025 .

DEA and ICE work with Homeland Security Investigations to investigate illicit drug activity with a connection to U.S. borders and ports of entry . DEA may cross-designate agents from other agencies to assist with enforcing the Controlled Substances Act .

GAO made recommendations to the DEA Administrator and Director of ICE . DEA and ICE should work together to develop and implement the two training modules in accordance with their January 2021 letter, using agreed-upon dispute resolution mechanisms as appropriate . DHS uses Federally Funded Research and Development Centers to meet special, long-term research and development needs that DHS and other contractors cannot meet as effectively .

The Department of Defense is the lead department responsible for detecting and monitoring the aerial and maritime transport of illicit drugs to the U.S. In fiscal year 2022, DOD allocated about $580 million to support detection and monitoring activities, intelligence activities, and activities in partner nations .

GAO found that the agreement had not been updated to address detection and monitoring of precursor chemicals used to develop fentanyl . Updated agreements could address confusion about the combatant commands’ roles and help DOD coordinate the joint operation area .

Terrorists’ ability to obtain radioactive materials for use in a radiological dispersal device— also known as a dirty bomb— has been of particular concern for federal agencies since the attacks of September 11, 2001 . Radioactive materials are commonly used throughout the U.S. for medical and industrial purposes such as treating cancer, sterilizing medical instruments, and detecting flaws in metal welds .

GAO investigators established fake businesses and licenses and used them to expose vulnerabilities in NRC’s regulations . Agency does not require all vendors that sell category 3 materials to verify the legitimacy of would-be purchasers’ category 3 licenses with the regulator . NRC estimated that implementing some of these recommendations would cost about $27 million over 10 years .

GAO: Federal IT investments too frequently fail to deliver capabilities in a timely manner . Investments often lack disciplined and effective management in areas such as project planning, requirements definition, and program oversight and governance . Congress enacted the Federal Information Technology Acquisition Reform Act in December 2014 . GAO found that none of the 24 agencies fully met the statutory requirements for annual IT portfolio reviews .

GAO made four recommendations to OMB and 30 recommendations to improve IT portfolio management . GAO maintains that the recommendations are warranted, as OMB did not fully meet the statutory requirements . OMB acknowledged the merit of some of the recommendations and agreed that improvements are needed in the management of federal IT investments .
GAO found examples of duplication among four systems that collect pandemic public health preparedness and response data . Further duplication among HHS’s 99 pandemic-related IT systems may exist .

GAO: HHS plans to consolidate multiple duplicative systems that support pandemic preparedness and response by August 2025 . If even one of these systems could be consolidated or decommissioned the agency could save hundreds of thousands of dollars . Federal agencies and the nation's critical infrastructure rely on cryptography (e.g., encryption) to protect sensitive data and systems .

GAO found that efforts to reduce textile waste and advance textile recycling are fragmented across multiple federal entities . The rise in fast fashion has highlighted concerns about the need for reducing textile waste . A comprehensive national quantum computing cybersecurity strategy coordinated by ONCD will help manage fragmentation and prevent potential overlap .

GAO spoke said that interagency collaboration is needed and would help their efforts on reducing textile waste and advancing textile recycling . GAO recommended that Congress consider providing direction and expressly delegate authority to a federal entity (or entities) to take coordinated federal action to reduce textile waste . EPA agreed with GAO’s findings, conclusions, and recommendations .
GAO found that while local agencies generally appreciated the food they received, officials reported challenges addressing deliveries of spoiled or damaged food in a timely manner .

GAO found that the Housing and Services Resource Center had made progress in fostering collaboration and partnerships to address the housing and services needs of older adults experiencing or at risk of homelessness . About 138,000 older adults (aged 55 and older) experienced homelessness on a single night in 2023 .

Many older adults need services and support as they age, such as nutrition assistance, community programs, and help in their homes . Demand for these services will continue to grow rapidly as the U.S. population continues to age . Services funded under the Older Americans Act received a total of $2.372 billion in appropriated funding for fiscal year 2024 .

Each year, approximately 200,000 service members transition from military service to civilian life . The transition period can be fraught with challenges, such as entering the civilian workforce . The suicide rate for veterans in the first year of separation was about 2.5 times higher than for active-duty population .

GAO made two recommendations to DOD and one recommendation to VA . DOD said it was continuing to assess warm handover data gaps and plans to assess the overall helpfulness of warm handovers . VA agreed with its recommendation .

The Department of the Navy plans to invest almost $130 billion to research, develop, and purchase 12 Columbia class submarines . The lead Columbia class submarine must be ready for its first patrol in fiscal year 2031 to avoid a gap in deterrence requirements .

GAO made two recommendations that the Department of the Navy ensure the Supervisors of Shipbuilding, Conversion, and Repair offices update planning . The Navy and shipbuilders can help avoid material delays that can lead to cost increases and costly rework needed to correct deficiencies . The Department of Defense agreed with these recommendations .

GAO: Fully utilizing digital engineering tools can help DOD’s hypersonic weapons efforts anticipate potential design flaws, optimize manufacturing, and reduce costs . 100 million dollars or more might be saved on three of the four remaining efforts .

GAO found that the Navy and its shipbuilder have faced persistent delays and challenges completing the frigate design . Delays and challenges are a result of the Navy’s decision to approve the shipbuilder to begin construction with an incomplete functional design .

As of February 2025, the Navy had implemented one recommendation and DOD officials stated the Navy has made progress on some of the others . Building even one of the six frigates at or below the contract’s target cost could save the Navy an estimated tens of millions of dollars .

In 2015, the Navy planned to modernize 11 of its cruisers by 2026 through the cruiser modernization effort . The Navy wasted $1.84 billion on four ships that were partially modernized but then retired before the end of their expected service lives . The modernization work experienced 36 percent cost growth in addition to schedule delays .
The Navy concurred with the recommendations and said it would take action to implement them . The Navy could save one hundred million dollars or more over the next 10 years .

GAO made three recommendations for the Air Force to demonstrate the minimum viable product for laser communications capability in space Tranche 0, 1, and 2 before proceeding with subsequent launch decisions .

In March 2025, SDA officials said that Tranche 0 was a prototype, did not have a minimum viable product, and was not necessary for subsequent development . This is a significant change from the way SDA previously characterized both Tranches 0 and 1 in planning documents and other sources .
The Department of Defense intends to spend over $2 billion through fiscal year 2029 to purchase a new fleet of planes . Congress has previously expressed concerns about the Armed Overwatch program .

GAO: DOE does not currently maintain or track data on contract award timeliness and delays . Delays in awarding contracts can increase costs to both DOE and industry . GAO cannot estimate the potential financial benefits resulting from this recommendation .

Department of the Interior’s Office of Natural Resources Revenue (ONRR) is responsible for collecting company-paid royalties . ONRR collected $74 billion in royalties on $600 billion in total sales of oil and gas produced by companies on federal leases .

In August 2024, GAO reported that ONRR had incomplete compliance data, faced resource challenges, and did not have a rigorous estimate of a federal oil and gas royalty gap . Incomplete data hindered ONRR’s compliance efforts . ONRR relied on an ineffective risk model developed by a vendor for selecting compliance cases .

DOE has historically planned to manage about 3 million gallons of this waste as a waste type called high-level radioactive waste . GAO recommends Congress clarify authority to manage portions of Hanford's tank waste as a waste type other than high-level radioactive waste . GAO maintains all the recommendations are warranted . EPA disagrees with the recommendation that DOE pause work on the High-Level Waste Facility .

Programs at the Small Business Administration (SBA) and Department of Labor (DOL) accounted for a large portion of COVID-19 relief funding . SBA provided more than $1 trillion in loans and grants, primarily through the Paycheck Protection Program and Economic Injury Disaster Loans program .

GAO made three recommendations for SBA to expand and document loan review processes for its Paycheck Protection Program and COVID-19 Economic Injury Disaster Loans program . SBA partially agreed with the recommendations and described activities that are anticipated to remedy the recommendations .

GAO: Federal award amounts received by nonfederal entities, such as states, local governments, tribal entities, and nonprofit organizations, have increased substantially in recent years . Award recipients must undergo a single audit of their financial statements and federal awards when they annually spend at least the applicable threshold ($750,000 or $1,000,000) GAO also found severe and persistent single audit deficiencies in $1.17 trillion of the reported $6.97 trillion (about 17%) of awards received directly from a federal agency .

GAO made five recommendations for OMB and one recommendation for GSA . OMB agreed with the recommendations . GAO estimates hundreds of millions of dollars in federal spending deficiencies could be discovered or resolved per year .

The Internal Revenue Service collects excise taxes from manufacturers, producers, and importers on the sale of sport fishing and archery equipment . For fiscal years 2007 through 2023, these excise taxes annually totaled, on average, about $206 million . The number of consumers who may be liable for these taxes is unknown .

GAO recommended that Congress consider making U.S. online marketplaces responsible for sport fishing and archery excise taxes on consumer import sales in which they are involved . GAO also made two recommendations to IRS to consolidate and make existing excise tax guidance easily accessible . Implementing these three recommendations could collect more tax revenue dedicated for fish and wildlife conservation .
